pages.en: In the morning it is sunny and warm. Lily and Tom want to play in the park, so Mum says, "Take your raincoats. It's going to rain."
pages.zh: 早上天气晴朗温暖。Lily 和 Tom 想去公园玩，妈妈说：“带上雨衣，要下雨了。”
pages.scene: A bright sunny morning at the front door, Mum handing Lily and Tom yellow raincoats, the children pointing at the blue sky and laughing.

pages.en: In the park, a big grey cloud comes. Then it starts to rain. The children put on their raincoats, but Max is very wet!
pages.zh: 在公园里，飘来一大片灰云，接着下起雨来。孩子们穿上了雨衣，可是 Max 被淋得湿透了！
pages.scene: Rain falling in a park under a big grey cloud, Lily wearing a yellow raincoat and Tom wearing a yellow raincoat, both laughing, Max soaking wet with drooping ears.

pages.en: After the rain, the sun comes out again. Tom and Lily jump in the water on the path. Now everyone is wet, and they laugh all the way home!
pages.zh: 雨停后，太阳又出来了。Tom 和 Lily 在小路的水坑里跳来跳去。现在大家都湿透了，他们一路笑着回家！
pages.scene: The sun shining after the rain, Tom wearing a yellow raincoat and Lily wearing a yellow raincoat jumping in big puddles on a park path, water splashing everywhere, Max jumping with them, everyone laughing.

questions.q: In the morning it is cold and windy.
The sun comes out after the rain.
